title: AWS Admin Policy Attached To Service Account
content: CloudTrail shows AttachRolePolicy adding AdministratorAccess to a workload role that normally has read-only permissions. The actor used a new source IP and the role accesses sensitive resources afterward.

expected.threat_summary: An administrator policy is attached to a cloud role, creating privilege expansion risk.
key_behaviors: administrator policy is attached to a cloud role
actor or source IP is unusual
hunt_checklist: Review cloud audit logs for AttachRolePolicy/SetIamPolicy/Add role assignment.
Identify actor, target role/service account, policy, source IP, user agent, and resource.
Review follow-on privileged API activity after the role change.
expected.correlation_logic: Correlate IAM policy attachment by actor, target role, policy, source IP, user agent, resource, and follow-on cloud API activity.
expected.escalation_condition: Escalate when admin privilege is granted to an unusual identity or workload without approval.
expected.analyst_notes: Hand-authored external gold standard case for accuracy/generalization evaluation.
